# crypto

```go
import "banyan/crypto"
```

Package crypto provides encryption and decryption operations for secure peer\-to\-peer communication in the Banyan network. It implements AES\-GCM based encryption with ECDH\-style key derivation for establishing shared secrets between peers.

The package supports multiple service keys for different identity contexts and provides methods for encrypting data, peer IDs, and managing service key registrations.

## func [NewManager](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/crypto/manager.go#L42>)

```go
func NewManager(host host.Host, serviceKey crypto.PrivKey) interfaces.CryptoManager
```

NewManager creates a new crypto manager with the given libp2p host and optional default service key. The service key is used for legacy single\-key operations while multiple keys can be registered via RegisterServiceKey.

<a name="Manager"></a>
## type [Manager](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/crypto/manager.go#L32-L37>)

Manager provides cryptographic operations for secure peer communication. It manages encryption keys and supports multiple service keys indexed by unique identifiers. The Manager uses AES\-256\-GCM for symmetric encryption with keys derived from ECDH\-style key material hashing.

<a name="Manager.DecryptPeerIDWithServiceKey"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [DecryptPeerIDWithServiceKey](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/crypto/manager.go#L259>)

```go
func (m *Manager) DecryptPeerIDWithServiceKey(encryptedPeerID, nonce []byte, requesterPubKey []byte) (string, error)
```

DecryptPeerIDWithServiceKey decrypts a peer ID that was encrypted using the service's public key. It uses the default service key registered with the manager. Returns the decrypted peer ID string.

<a name="Manager.DecryptPeerIDWithSpecificServiceKey"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [DecryptPeerIDWithSpecificServiceKey](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/crypto/manager.go#L312>)

```go
func (m *Manager) DecryptPeerIDWithSpecificServiceKey(encryptedPeerID, nonce []byte, requesterPubKey []byte, servicePrivKey crypto.PrivKey) (string, error)
```

DecryptPeerIDWithSpecificServiceKey decrypts a peer ID using a specific service private key rather than the default. This allows decryption when multiple service keys are in use.

<a name="Manager.DecryptWithLocatorKey"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [DecryptWithLocatorKey](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/crypto/manager.go#L177>)

```go
func (m *Manager) DecryptWithLocatorKey(encryptedData, nonce []byte, senderServicePubKeyBytes []byte, locatorPrivKey crypto.PrivKey) ([]byte, error)
```

DecryptWithLocatorKey decrypts data using a locator's ephemeral private key and the sender's service public key. This is used when a locator receives encrypted data from a service peer.

<a name="Manager.DecryptWithPublicKey"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [DecryptWithPublicKey](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/crypto/manager.go#L101>)

```go
func (m *Manager) DecryptWithPublicKey(encryptedData, nonce []byte, senderPubKeyBytes []byte) ([]byte, error)
```

DecryptWithPublicKey decrypts data that was encrypted using the local peer's public key. It derives the same shared key used during encryption by combining the local private key with the sender's public key.

<a name="Manager.EncryptPeerIDWithServiceKey"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [EncryptPeerIDWithServiceKey](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/crypto/manager.go#L208>)

```go
func (m *Manager) EncryptPeerIDWithServiceKey(peerID string, servicePubKey crypto.PubKey) ([]byte, []byte, error)
```

EncryptPeerIDWithServiceKey encrypts a peer ID using the local peer's private key and a service's public key. This allows a peer to securely share its identity with a service. Returns the ciphertext and nonce.

<a name="Manager.EncryptWithPublicKey"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [EncryptWithPublicKey](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/crypto/manager.go#L55>)

```go
func (m *Manager) EncryptWithPublicKey(data []byte, requesterPubKeyBytes []byte) ([]byte, []byte, error)
```

EncryptWithPublicKey encrypts data using a derived shared key based on the local peer's private key and the requester's public key. It returns the ciphertext and a randomly generated nonce. The shared key is derived by hashing the concatenation of the local private key bytes and the requester's public key bytes.

<a name="Manager.EncryptWithServiceKey"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [EncryptWithServiceKey](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/crypto/manager.go#L145>)

```go
func (m *Manager) EncryptWithServiceKey(data []byte, requesterPubKeyBytes []byte, servicePrivKey crypto.PrivKey) ([]byte, []byte, error)
```

EncryptWithServiceKey encrypts data using a specific service private key and the requester's public key. This allows encryption on behalf of a service identity rather than the peer's identity. Returns the ciphertext and a randomly generated nonce.
